children: Asian currencies are mixed in early morning trading. Investors are focusing on U.S. economic data due this week, including the latest nonfarm payrolls report and ADP private payrolls. The readings will be scrutinized for further evidence on the strength of the U.S. labor market and the broader economy, after recent mixed indicators, UOB's Global Economics & Markets Research says in a note. The U.S. dollar is 0.1% higher at 157.73 yen, while the Australian dollar is little changed at US$0.7033, LSEG data show.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
